initialExam.title: Jharkhand Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Jharkhand Police Constable recruitment through JSSC for constable posts in Jharkhand state police and India Reserve Battalion.
initialExam.syllabus: Hindi, English, GK, Jharkhand GK, Mathematics, Reasoning, Science.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 120 questions, 360 marks, 2 hours. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Efficiency Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit jssc.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
